name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Pantry pasta with garlic, chili, and olive oil.

steps.text: Boil salted water and cook spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Warm olive oil over medium-low heat. Add garlic and chili flakes; cook until fragrant, not brown.
Toss drained pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with parsley and more salt if needed. Serve immediately.

notes: If the garlic browns, start the oil again — bitter garlic ruins the dish.
